hooks.name: Console links on error
hooks.description: After a shell command, if its output shows errors (HTTP 500, faults, or a break-* scenario), print the AWS observability console URLs for the stack.

action.command: input=$(cat); echo "$input" | grep -qiE 'HTTP 500|break-(table|exception|latency)|"fault"|AccessDenied|ResourceNotFound|\\[ERROR\\]' && { echo "⚠️ Errors detected — observability consoles:"; cd "$(echo "$input" | sed -n 's/.*"cwd"[: ]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1)" 2>/dev/null || true; just console-urls 2>/dev/null || echo "(run 'just console-urls' for links; stack may not be deployed)"; }; exit 0
